request.description:
GET [http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes](http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes)  
Authorization: Bearer (admin)  
Expected: Returns paginated list of all disputes

GET http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes?status=OPEN  
Authorization: Bearer (admin)  
Expected: Returns only disputes with status=OPEN

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/1/resolve](http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/1/resolve)  
Authorization: Bearer (admin)  
Content-Type: application/json  
{  
"resolution": "PROVIDER_FULL",  
"resolutionNotes": "Provider completed work satisfactorily"  
}  
Expected:  
\- Dispute status → RESOLVED  
\- Transaction status → RESOLVED  
\- Job status → COMPLETED  
\- Provider balance increases by full amount  
\- Both parties receive emails  
\- Appeal deadline set to 3 days from now  
{  
"disputeId": 4,  
"transactionId": 7,  
"status": "RESOLVED",  
"openedAt": "2026-01-02T01:08:49.777847",  
"resolvedAt": "2026-01-05T03:13:07.8916566",  
"evidencePhotos": \[  
{  
"photoId": 2,  
"photoUrl": "uploads/disputes/file_0_827dd769-9b34-495a-b384-b192383f295d.jpg",  
"uploadedAt": "2026-01-02T01:08:49.787567"  
}  
\]  
}

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/1/resolve](http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/1/resolve)  
\# \*_(dispute status is already RESOLVED)  
\*_Expected:  
\- 409 Conflict

{  
"status": 409,  
"message": "Cannot resolve dispute. Dispute must be OPEN or UNDER_REVIEW but is RESOLVED",  
"timestamp": "2026-01-05T04:33:32.116209",  
"errors": null  
}

POST http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/2/resolve  
Authorization: Bearer (admin token)  
Content-Type: application/json  
{  
"resolution": "CUSTOMER_FULL",  
"resolutionNotes": "Work was not completed as agreed"  
}  
**Expected:**  
\- Dispute status → RESOLVED  
\- Transaction status → RESOLVED  
\- Job status → CANCELLED  
\- Customer balance increases by full amount  
\- Both parties receive emails

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/3/resolve](http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/3/resolve)  
Authorization: Bearer (admin token)  
Content-Type: application/json  
{  
"resolution": "SPLIT",  
"resolutionNotes": "Work was partially completed",  
"providerSplitPercentage": 60.00,  
"customerSplitPercentage": 40.00  
}  
Expected:  
\- Dispute status → RESOLVED  
\- Transaction status → RESOLVED  
\- Job status → COMPLETED  
\- Provider gets 60% of amount  
\- Customer gets 40% of amount  
\- Both balances updated correctly  
\- Both parties receive emails

{  
"disputeId": 2,  
"transactionId": 9,  
"status": "RESOLVED",  
"openedAt": "2026-01-02T01:00:43.420619",  
"resolvedAt": "2026-01-05T03:25:11.735248",  
"evidencePhotos": \[\]  
}

---

**SPLIT with Invalid Percentages (Don’t Sum to 100)**  
POST http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/3/resolve  
Content-Type: application/json  
{  
"resolution": "SPLIT",  
"providerSplitPercentage": 50.00,  
"customerSplitPercentage": 60.00 // 50 + 60 = 110, not 100!  
}  
Expected:  
\- 400 Bad Request  
\- Error: "Split percentages must sum to exactly 100%"

POST http://localhost:8080/api/admin/disputes/4/resolve  
Authorization: Bearer (admin token)  
Content-Type: application/json  
{  
"resolution": "FIX_REQUIRED",  
"resolutionNotes": "Provider must fix the electrical outlets that are not working"  
}  
**Expected:**  
\- Dispute status → RESOLVED  
\- Transaction status → DISPUTED (stays in escrow!)  
\- Job status → IN_PROGRESS (provider can fix)  
\- NO money distribution  
\- Both parties receive fix-required emails

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/1/appeal](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/1/appeal)  
Authorization: Bearer (provider/customer token)  
Content-Type: application/json  
{  
"appealReason": "I disagree with this decision because the work was completed fully"

}  
Expected:  
\- DisputeAppeal created  
\- Dispute status → APPEALED  
\- Admin receives email notification  
\- User is either customer or provider from the dispute

{  
"message": "Appeal submitted successfully",  
"disputeId": 4,  
"appealId": 5,  
"status": "APPEALED"  
}

---

Try to Appeal - Access Denied (Wrong User)  
POST [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/1/appeal](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/1/appeal)  
Authorization: Bearer (another user)  
Expected:  
\- 400 Bad Request  
{  
"status": 400,  
"message": "You are not authorized to appeal this dispute. Only the customer or provider involved can appeal.",  
"timestamp": "2026-01-05T04:24:19.6521607",  
"errors": null  
}

---

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/1/appeal](http://localhost:8080/api/disputes/1/appeal)  
\# (dispute already has an appeal)  
Expected:  
\- 409 Conflict

{  
"message": "Appeal submitted successfully",  
"disputeId": 5,  
"appealId": 6,  
"status": "APPEALED"  
}
